description: This file defines constants and a function related to matrix extension identifiers and their root paths in a project. It imports a utility to determine plugin root paths and exports an array of extension IDs, a mapped array of their root paths, and a function to check if a given root is recognized as a matrix extension root.

methods.name: isMatrixExtensionRoot
methods.description: Checks if the provided root path is among the recognized matrix extension root paths.
